definitions.explanation: The state or condition of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧。
⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioner isn't working properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The car wasn't running well, so I took it in for repairs.

examples.japanese: {具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{休|やす}みます→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I'm not feeling well, so I'll take the day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I haven't been feeling well since yesterday, so I plan to go to the hospital today.

notes:
{具合|ぐあい} refers to the condition or state of things—especially health or how well something is functioning.

FOR HEALTH:
- {具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: not feeling well
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{具合|ぐあい}: physical condition
- {具合|ぐあい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: How are you feeling?

FOR THINGS:
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: the machine isn't working well
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{具合|ぐあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: just right, nicely

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {具合|ぐあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: condition is good/bad
- ⟦{塩梅|あんばい}→塩梅：07503_anbai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: condition is good (synonym, older expression)
